text: Relocation agencies make it easier to move to Germany. A relocation agency can help you… Apply for a residence permit Book a Bürgeramt appointment Find an apartment and register your address Fill and translate documents Go to the Ausländerbehörde with you

Relocation consultants help you move to Berlin and deal with German bureaucracy, but they can’t give you legal advice. Immigration lawyers give legal advice. They only help you with immigration: residence permits, permanent residence and citizenship. If you have legal questions, you need a lawyer. Find an immigration lawyer Other people who can help
